verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents an org-level service connection for Sprites: a service is connected once and every Sprite can reach it without pasting tokens, with scoped grants and one-step credential rotation. That removes credential hand-wiring, but nothing shows code-level bindings that replace SDK setup, and the feature appears limited to Sprites rather than general Fly Apps. A hands-on report that Postgres failed to link to an app when following the guide also tempers confidence. missing for 10: code-level native bindings that remove SDK boilerplate, documented bindings for databases/storage across regular Fly Apps, depth of docs on supported services, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect my code to external services like databases, APIs, and storage through native bindings with minimal boilerplate instead of hand-wiring SDKs and credentials

citations.quote: Connect a service once for your whole org, and every Sprite can reach it. Nobody pastes a token.
Grant access on purpose: by Sprite name, by label, or down to a single endpoint
Rotate once and every Sprite has the new credential.
